pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are shaped as irregular polygons with rounded vertices. Due to image resolution and focus, edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients rather than sharp transitions. Patches occupy the majority of the visible surface area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored negative space forms a continuous network of pathways with frequent tri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively wide and uniform across the visible flank and neck regions.
